mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5% and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% MoM and the S&P 500 still produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for three consecutive months and the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% MoM and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is below 4% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 MoM, but the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases by more than 10% YoY and the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) is stagnant or declining, it signals a supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth < 2% and INDPRO stagnant/declining
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY growth is below 2% and INDPRO is stagnant or declining, but the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
